invented_facts: The battery test used 8B inference; the paper specifies continuous local language-model inference but does not identify the model.
notes: The summary omits required caveats that only one Vantage configuration was tested, the models were 4-bit quantized, output quality was not evaluated, and the video-playback rating was measured at 150 nits. It also leaves out several test conditions, including AC power for non-battery tests and the image-generation resolution.
